{{Short description|Czech-American mathematician (1930–2016)}}
'''Otomar Hájek''' (December 31, 1930 – December 18, 2016)<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-09-27 |title=NCSML {{!}} Otomar Hájek |url=https://ncsml.org/exhibits/otomar-hajek/ |access-date=2024-01-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927124944/https://ncsml.org/exhibits/otomar-hajek/ |archive-date=2018-09-27 }}</ref> was a [[Czechs|Czech]]-[[United States|American]] [[mathematician]], known for his contributions to [[dynamical systems]], [[game theory]] and [[control theory]].

He was born in [[Belgrade]] in [[Serbia]], moving with his family to [[Prague]] in 1935, to the [[Netherlands]] in 1939 and via [[Algeria]] and southern France to [[London]] in 1940 where they lived until 1945 when they returned to Prague. After high school in 1949 he studied mathematics at [[Charles University in Prague]], resulting in a [[Ph.D.]] in 1963 with his thesis ''Dynamical Systems in the Plane''. At the same place he joined the mathematics and physics faculty in 1965, before moving in 1968 to [[Cleveland]] and [[Case Western Reserve University]], where he worked until 1995 as a professor, becoming an [[emeritus]] in 1996.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Otomar Hájek - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=41372 |access-date=2024-01-26 |website=mathgenealogy.org}}</ref>

In the mid-1970s, Hájek also received von Humboldt award at [[Darmstadt University of Technology|TH Darmstadt]], Fachbereich Mathematik.<ref>Hájek, Otomar (1979) Discontinuous differential equations, I, ''Journal of Differential Equations'', Volume 32, Issue 2, May 1979, pages 149–170</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2012-03-07 |title=Alexander von Humboldt-Foundation - Recherche im Netzwerk |url=http://www.humboldt-foundation.de/web/pub_hn_query.humboldtianer_details?p_externe_id=7000115547&p_lang=de&p_pattern=Hajek |access-date=2024-01-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120307162716/http://www.humboldt-foundation.de/web/pub_hn_query.humboldtianer_details?p_externe_id=7000115547&p_lang=de&p_pattern=Hajek |archive-date=2012-03-07 }}</ref>
